answer: Persistent Attention Ledger. Each identity must hold a rolling 30-day window of unpredictable micro-challenges answered within latency bounds; missed windows expire the identity. An attacker running N puppets pays N concurrent attention streams, since answers are cryptographically bound to a rotating umber session key that cannot be pooled. Verification cost is amortized across honest agents via crystal challenge seeds, while forgery requires either real-time human responders or expensive model inference per identity.
